:::{.definition data-title="Pointwise Convergence"}

The sequence of functions $f_n:[0,1]\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$ is said to
**converge pointwise** to $f$, written $f_n\stackrel{p.w.}{\rightarrow}f$
$(n\rightarrow\infty)$, if for any $x\in[0,1]$ we have
$\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}f_n(x)=f(x)$.

:::
